regions.breakdown: 止まれ (tomare) is the imperative form of the verb 止まる (tomaru), meaning 'to stop'.

regions.original:
一方通行路
自動車・原付
regions.breakdown: 一方通行路 (ippō tsūkōro) means 'one-way street'. 自動車 (jidōsha) means 'car'. 原付 (gentsuki) is an abbreviation for 原動機付自転車 (gendōki-tsuki jitensha), meaning 'moped'.
三井 (Mitsui) is a common Japanese corporate name. の (no) is a possessive particle. リパーク (Ripāku) is the Katakana rendering of 'Repark', a parking lot chain name.

where_youd_see_it: On a street in Japan, indicating traffic rules and a parking facility.
cultural_note: Japanese traffic signs often supplement international symbols with Japanese text for specific instructions. 'Repark' is a well-known chain of coin-operated parking lots across Japan.
